lines.zh: 长腿迈开，我在地上连跳。
lines.en: Long legs stride and I hop along the ground.
My wings half-furled at my sides.
My long legs stride wide.
My claws grip the grass roots.
I cross a stony patch.
When the wind comes, I open a wing.
I walk along behind my owner.
My feathers shine in the sun.
I look down at the ground.
I go around a bush.
I ease along the rock edge.
My shadow falls wide.
I always catch up.
I groom under my wing.
I tilt my head at the sky.
I smooth my feathers.
The sun feels warm.
I hear the wind far off.
My claws scuff the ground.
I wait for a signal.

lines.zh: 我轻轻咕了一声，没人应。
lines.en: I give a soft coo; no one answers.
I hear you past my ear.
Wind combs my feathers; I don't move.
I settle down to rest.
My shadow is larger than I am.
Wind lifts my feathers.
Insects in the grass.
I stand taller than you.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，你就在我影里。
lines.en: I lower myself and you're inside my shadow.
That meat in your palm for me?

lines.zh: 鞍还没放上来，我就看着你。
lines.en: No saddle on me yet, and still I watch you.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀上可以站一只鹰。
lines.en: An eagle could perch on that shoulder.
I tilt my head to meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着肉干的味道。
lines.en: Your sleeve smells of dried meat.
My wingspan is very wide.
What's that reaching hand for?
I dislike being chased.
This distance is right.

lines.zh: 背上的位置，刚好够你坐。
lines.en: There's just room on my back for you.
Tiring to look up, isn't it.
I've left you half a pace.
You have no feathers.

lines.zh: 你站定不动，羽毛才不炸。
lines.en: Stand still and my feathers stay flat.
I won't lunge first.
I'll remember this smell for a long while.
Come closer. There's no need to fear.
I wait for your next move.
Your hand lifts halfway, then drops.
One long flight feather broke.

lines.zh: 我一侧歪，忙用翅膀撑住。
lines.en: I tip sideways and catch myself with a wing.
My wing won't fold.
I let out a sharp cry.
Blood on my feathers.
My feathers are a mess, but I'm still standing.
I can still fly with this.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩翅膀，血点飞开。
lines.en: I shake my wings and blood flecks fly off.
I know those hands.
I can still guard you.
Is that a strip of meat?
I don't eat grain.
Put it down; don't keep it clenched.
A little closer is fine.
That strip is still wet.
I can take it myself.
Don't pull your hand back.
Flatten your hand and let me touch it.
Palm up is better.
That's barely enough to take the edge off.
That strip is too thin.
One more strip, then.
I could follow you.
Don't let your hand shake.

lines.zh: 这条肉干，我闻着就走不动。
lines.en: One whiff of that jerky and I can't walk away.
You needn't keep holding it up.

lines.zh: 我再挪半步，就够到你的手。
lines.en: Half a step more and I reach your hand.
You bumped my chest.
One spread of my wings and I'm fine.
You stepped on my claw.
My wing braced me.
My feathers brushed you.
I fold one wing in.
It's nothing to me.
You've got feathers on you now.
Steady. The stones are slick.
Don't come up behind me.
Mine is the common coloring.
Let me learn you first.
I want to see how you fly.
No wings. That complicates things.
Wait for a northwest wind.
My nest is still up the mountain.
Not so close.
I'll bring you a strip of meat first.
Let's fly a stretch together.
You look fine when you smile.
My claw tip hooked it.
This is far too light.
I'll carry it to you.
If it drops, it's lost.
A flick of my talon to see what it is.
I nudged it with my beak.
This bone is useful.
Don't take it. I'm keeping it.
I could fly back for it.
Put it in the pouch on my back.
There's something that way.

lines.zh: 我张满两翼，风灌进羽毛。
lines.en: I spread both wings and the wind fills my feathers.
My owner hasn't sent me.
That smell is wrong.
My wings half open.

lines.zh: 四趾扣进土里，我压低身子。
lines.en: Four toes dig in and I drop low.

lines.zh: 那团影子已经被我锁定。
lines.en: That shape is locked in my sight.
If it's a fight, now.
I'll go first on this one.
It isn't afraid of me at all.
I pace over to the flank.
My wings stay half open.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，等它走进范围。
lines.en: Wings half open, I wait for it to come in range.
I won't take off yet.
Its hand is on a weapon.

lines.zh: 它的影子一动，我就数一步。
lines.en: Each time its shadow moves, I count a step.
Uneven ground. I plant my feet.
Three more paces.
It looked away first.
Claws reach forward.
Both talons drive down together.
My beak flicks its wrist.
My wings shove it aside.
That claw came in low.
I tear with my beak.
Let go of my talon.
It shrank back a few steps.
I slam down, then bounce back into the air.
That claw was for my owner.
My beak falls right behind the talons.
I come down from the slope.
My wings block the light.
I fold my wings and settle.
My feathers are neat.
This updraft is strong enough to hold me.

lines.zh: 我在坡上盘旋，找一个身影。
lines.en: I circle the slope, looking for one figure.

lines.zh: 落地时土被我的爪子压陷。
lines.en: The ground gives under my talons as I land.
A familiar scent far off.
I land beside you.

lines.zh: 一声长鸣，从坡顶落下来。
lines.en: A long call drops from the ridge top.
My feathers turned brittle with heat.
My claws went numb on landing.
My wings are too heavy in water.
The shockwave blows my feathers straight up.
An arrow went through my wing.
The light makes my feathers hot.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，翅膀抬不起来。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I can't lift my wings.
The strike raised every feather.
No place to land below.
